correctness.rationale: From the exact published numerator sums, interval summation yields a reciprocal sextic for both r=1 and r=2. The transformed cubic has a strictly negative factored discriminant and one real root less than -2. Local scaling at the double limiting root -1 gives u=-1±i sqrt(2)/k+o(1/k), hence radial speed n(1-|s|)->sqrt(6). Exact finite computations corroborate but do not prove the identities.
